description: This file contains implementation of Android's IOMX interface, including classes for OMX node communication (BpOMXNode, HpOMXNode), observer handling (BpOMXObserver), and transaction handling (BnOMXNode, BnOMXObserver). It defines methods for managing OMX components, such as parameter setting, buffer management, and message dispatching.

classes.name: BpOMXNode
classes.description: Proxy class for IOMXNode interface, handling IPC communication with OMX nodes.

classes.name: HpOMXNode
classes.description: Hybrid class combining BpOMXNode and LWOmxNode for local and remote OMX node interactions.

classes.name: BpOMXObserver
classes.description: Proxy class for IOMXObserver interface, sending OMX messages to observers.

classes.name: BnOMXNode
classes.description: Binder class handling incoming transactions for IOMXNode, implementing server-side logic.

classes.name: BnOMXObserver
classes.description: Binder class handling incoming messages for IOMXObserver, implementing server-side logic.

methods.name: freeNode
methods.description: Requests to free the OMX node.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command to the OMX node.

methods.name: getParameter
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter from the OMX node.

methods.name: setParameter
methods.description: Sets a parameter on the OMX node.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves configuration from the OMX node.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets configuration on the OMX node.

methods.name: setPortMode
methods.description: Configures port mode for the OMX node.

methods.name: getGraphicBufferUsage
methods.description: Gets graphic buffer usage for a port.

methods.name: useBuffer
methods.description: Provides a buffer to the OMX node.

methods.name: setInputSurface
methods.description: Sets input surface for the OMX node.

methods.name: prepareForAdaptivePlayback
methods.description: Prepares OMX node for adaptive playback.

methods.name: configureVideoTunnelMode
methods.description: Configures video tunnel mode.

methods.name: allocateSecureBuffer
methods.description: Allocates a secure buffer.

methods.name: freeBuffer
methods.description: Frees a buffer.

methods.name: fillBuffer
methods.description: Fills a buffer with data.

methods.name: emptyBuffer
methods.description: Empties a buffer, submitting data.

methods.name: getExtensionIndex
methods.description: Retrieves extension index for a parameter.

methods.name: dispatchMessage
methods.description: Dispatches a message to the OMX node.

methods.name: setQuirks
methods.description: Sets quirks for OMX node behavior.

methods.name: onMessages
methods.description: Handles incoming messages in IOMXObserver.
